opening.argument: The video is framed as a Laptop Mag review of Apple’s technical support, reporting that Apple topped the rankings for its phone and web assistance and that Henry tested the service undercover. The described viewer actions are ordinary support-seeking: using Apple’s website to request a callback, accessing support through Twitter, and receiving links intended to answer technical questions. The review also assesses support knowledge of Siri and the Touch Bar, while the visible prompt concerns setting up a support callback. This is an evaluation of routine customer service and product information, with no payment request, investment offer, credential request, or deceptive benefit flow.

citations.quote: Topping our tech support rankings for the third year in a row, Apple has the best combination of phone and web support.
Henry went undercover to test their tech support
I would use their website to click to have them call me.
Siri and the touch bar they aced.
